acceptanceCriteria: A context packet or corvint_query result includes matching notes with trust label, freshness and omitted counts under a fixed byte cap.
The read writes no store, intent or index bytes.
Ranking, evidence and authority outputs are byte-identical with and without notes present.
body: V1-0955 (issue 655) delivers anchored know-how notes only on claim / claim --next and an explicit list. Issue 655 also asks for delivery through corvint_query. Deliver notes whose anchors intersect the query/packet scope as a pure read with the UNTRUSTED_AGENT_AUTHORED_DATA label, freshness (CURRENT/STALE/UNKNOWN) and a byte cap with omitted counts; never an input to ranking, evidence or authority.
title: Know-how notes: deliver through corvint_query and Core context packets, labelled untrusted, under a cap (V1-0955 follow-up, issue 655)
